thought.text: Two of three dev servers (app 34237, boards 38377) return HTTP 200 directly. The cms dev server (35581) appears to have died (000). Let me check its log and restart it.

reasoning_content:
All 10 containers are running (8 are healthy). Dev servers: app (34237) HTTP 200, boards (38377) HTTP 200. The CMS (35581) dev server appears to have stopped (000 = no response). Let's check what happened with the CMS. It had been returning 200 earlier, so it may have stopped during one of the sandbox interruptions. Let's restart it and confirm that all three return 200.

Let's check the CMS log and restart it.

action.command:
echo "=== cms direct log tail ==="; tail -5 /tmp/cms-direct.log 2>/dev/null; echo "=== restart cms ==="; cd /workspace/app && nohup pnpm nx serve cms --configuration=instance --port=35581 --host=0.0.0.0 --allowedHosts=cms.workspace.localhost > /tmp/cms-direct2.log 2>&1 &
echo "cms pid $!"
